title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Rule 7 table contradicts prose desc
description: Line 113 states Rule 7 supports both link-local and global addresses via address-mode bit and a direction bit + residue for non-10883 ports. However, the table at lines 117-130 shows IPv6 prefixes fixed to fe80::/64 (link-local only) with MO=equal/CDA=not-sent, and both UDP ports fixed to 10883 with MO=equal. The table does not reflect the flexible address-mode or port handling described in the prose.
